simple.meaning: אַח (ʼach) is a Hebrew word meaning “brother.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אַח (H252) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezra 7:18, with occurrences in Ezra.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אַח (H252) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אַח (H252) before moving outward to related references.
